text:
Type: adjustable white desk lamp
Use: directed light for reading and working at a desk; home office, study, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, contemporary, retro
Materials: white plastic shade, silver-grey painted metal stem and base, white cord with switch
Colors: white, light silver grey
Shape: rounded bucket-shaped shade on a swivel joint, sliding side arm, gently S-curved stem, round flat base, compact and light
Feel: friendly, practical, soft, tidy
Goes with: white or light wood desks, grey accents, pale walls; Scandinavian or contemporary home offices and bedrooms

product.name: SVIRVEL
product.description: You can easily direct the light where you want it because the lamp head is adjustable.
